sn46.40:1.1: paññānirodhikā vighātapakkhiyā → paññānirodhiyā vighāta pakkhiyā (bj) | paññānirodhikā → paññānirodhiyā (sya-all) | paññānirodhikā → S1-3 nirodhiyā-yaṁ always (S1 nirodhisā here) (pts note) | anibbānasaṁvattanikā → S1 anibbānāya saṁ- (pts note)
sn46.40:1.3: paññānirodhikaṁ → paññānirodhiyaṁ (bj, sya-all) | andhakaraṇaṁ acakkhukaraṇaṁ aññāṇakaraṇaṁ → andhakaraṇam āññāṇakaraṇam acakkhukaraṇam (pts)
sn46.40:1.7: paññānirodhikaṁ → paññānirodhiyaṁ (bj, sya-all) | aññāṇakaraṇam → S1 apaññāṇa- (pts note)
sn46.40:2.1: paññābuddhiyā → paññāvuddhiyā (bj, pts); paññāvuḍḍhiyā (sya-all) | paññāvuddhiyā → missing in S1-3. B1 -buddhiy- always (pts note)
sn46.40:2.4: paññābuddhiyā → paññāvuddhiyā (bj); paññāvuḍḍhiyā (sya-all) | ñāṇakaraṇā paññābuddhiyā → ñaṇakaraṇā paññavuddhiyā (pts)
sn46.40:3.1: kilesā → kileso (bj, sya-all) | ca → S1-3 Dve kusalakileso ca. (pts note)
sn46.40:3.2: buddhi → vuḍḍhi (sya-all); vuddhi (pts) | ca → S1-3 Yoniso ca vuddhiyā instead of dve-; B1 has buddhi. (pts note)
sn46.40:3.3: āvaraṇā nīvaraṇā → anāvaraṇā aparihāni nīvaraṇāvaraṇā (sya-all); āvaraṇo aparihāni nīvaraṇavaraṇa (pts) | Aparihāni → S1-3 āvaraṇaṁ [S3 anā-] varaṇaṁ both, omitting aparihāni -nīvaraṇavaranā. (pts note) | Nīvaraṇavaraṇa → B2 nīvaraṇāvaraṇā. (pts note) | Rukkhaṁ → S1-3 rukkhagge. (pts note)
sn46.40:3.4: nīvaraṇañca → nīvaraṇena ca (sya-all) | dasāti → dasāti sāvatthi nidānaṁ (pts) | dasāti → S1-3 Nīvaraṇena cāti. -- This entangled Uddāna does not agree easily with the texts. (pts note)
